issue_context.title: Log when Head compaction results in an empty block
issue_context.body:
We already do it when compacting multiple blocks
https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/3240cf83f08e448e0b96a4a1f96c0e8b2d51cf61/tsdb/compact.go#L433-L438

Compaction of Head block resulting in an empty blocks goes unnoticed currently. We should log that too.

For contributors, the log should go just before this return
https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/3240cf83f08e448e0b96a4a1f96c0e8b2d51cf61/tsdb/compact.go#L491

And the log should include the `mint` and `maxt` of the compaction attempted.
comments: Might this result in even more logspam when a Prometheus that hasn't run in a while is started back up?

> Might this result in even more logspam when a Prometheus that hasn't run in a while is started back up?

Yes, but it is better than no logs. Faced this first hand, without the logs we were not able to figure out what was happening and why was checkpointing happening so often with no indication of any compaction.

review_comments:
maybe we could leave the return statement here and just add the log message right above it, then we could remove the else statement below

reading the Prometheus codebase, I think we avoid `else` whenever it's possible to improve readability

Since `Compact` method is using as such, i was following the format to achieve consistency. 
https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/09a31ef6cfb052b4bfc8461b40a9dfed996aaeb1/tsdb/compact.go#L432-L441
Maybe change `Compact` accordingly as well? Then we achieve consistency and better readability
The case with `Compact` is a little different, `if else` would be required there

```suggestion
			"msg", "compaction resulted in empty block",
```

Since it's called by LeveledCompactor, I think it might make things clearer for the one reading this log message
`write block` is fine because it's explicit about which method was called (see the below log)
